_description: Raw DVSA operator-licence operating-centre data, captured from vehicle-operator-licensing.service.gov.uk/view-details/licence/<id>. Each OC's `vehicles` is that operating centre's own authorised maximum (these do NOT sum to the licence total — the total is a separate licence-wide cap). Source for build-garage-capacity.js, which matches OC postcodes to our garages. Refresh via the bookmarklet in capacity/extract-bookmarklet.js (no screenshots needed) — see data.md.
